# WM BFSG AST Remediator

> WordPress plugin (`v1.1.2`) that buffers frontend pages and applies five fixed rules to the HTML before it is sent: a lang attribute, a skip link to the main landmark, alt attributes on images, aria-label on form controls without any name, and names for several navigations. It does not audit pages, keeps no statistics and makes no compliance assessment.

## Overview


- Engine: `WM_BFSG_DOM_Transformer::transform()` with `WM_BFSG_Rules_Engine`, one implementation for frontend, simulator, CLI and hub self-test
- REST: `wm-bfsg/v1` — `POST /remediate-html` (administrators)
- WP-CLI: `wp bfsg status`, `wp bfsg remediate <file> [--write]`
- Hooks: `wm_bfsg_remediator_rules_config`, `wm_bfsg_remediator_html_output`, `wm_bfsg_remediator_ready`
- Block Bindings & GenerateBlocks: `wm-bfsg-remediator/status` and `{{wm_bfsg_remediator_status}}`
- Options: `wm_bfsg_remediator_enabled`, `wm_bfsg_fix_skip_links`, `wm_bfsg_fix_images`, `wm_bfsg_fix_labels`, `wm_bfsg_fix_aria`, `wm_bfsg_remediator_delete_data_on_uninstall`
- Documentation measured against the code: README.md, DEVELOPERS.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

## Standards

- Version 1.2.2.
- PHP 8.1+ with ext-dom and ext-mbstring / strict types / WordPress coding style (tabs)
- Self-hosted assets in `/assets/`; parser without network access (LIBXML_NONET)
- Nonce & capability checks / late escaping / opt-in data removal on uninstall
